verdict.rationale: Groq's docs never surface an explicit public price list in this pack, and pricing-adjacent docs (flex/batch cost multipliers) imply a baseline public price exists for on-demand models, but a first-hand community report states Groq switched some newer models to 'call us for quotes' rather than posting per-token prices, directly contradicting the claim that every hosted model has transparent public pricing. Missing for 10: an actual public pricing page citation, and confirmation that all current models (not just legacy ones) list per-token prices without sales contact.
